summary: Frontend-only testing of FozPay redesign iteration (light emerald theme) + new payout filters on /requests. All 8 requested criteria verified green via Playwright against the preview URL.
verified_criteria: Admin login (psymaks249@gmail.com / FozPay2025Admin!) succeeds -> redirects to /dashboard, no runtime console errors (only 2 benign pre-login 401s on /auth/me)
Landing / loads in new LIGHT theme; hero H1 = 'Прийом платежів у криптовалюті для вашого бізнесу'; old tagline 'Крипто-еквайринг нового покоління • Без KYC для транзиту' is NOT present
payout-search, payout-period, payout-count testids present on /requests payouts section
payout-period dropdown exposes exactly: Увесь час, Сьогодні, Останні 7 днів, Останні 30 днів, Свій період
Selecting 'Свій період' reveals payout-date-from and payout-date-to inputs
Typing in payout-search updates counter (observed 'Знайдено: 0' with empty DB — acceptable) and controls do not throw
payout-reset button appears only when search/period is non-default and clears filters when clicked
'Дата' column header exists in the payouts (API) table
/wallet and /settings pages load cleanly in new theme without console errors
Mobile sidebar toggle opens sidebar and renders sidebar-backdrop (data-testid='sidebar-backdrop')
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage.js is ~420 lines and holds two full language dictionaries + layout — fine for now but consider extracting L dictionary and SectionHead to separate files if it grows further.
Requests.js filteredPayouts correctly handles empty payout list; no issues.
seed_data_creation: none — DB has no payouts; empty-state behavior validated per instructions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payouts table is empty in DB. All new filter controls on /requests are wired and emit no runtime errors. Light emerald theme active across landing, login, dashboard, requests, wallet, settings. If backend ever starts returning payout rows, re-verify date-range filtering boundary logic in Requests.js filteredPayouts (uses created_ts in seconds).
